description: Java source code for EntityDataLoadContainer class, responsible for loading various data types in the OFBiz framework, including data loading, constraint management, and component entity creation.

classes.name: EntityDataLoadContainer
classes.description: Container class responsible for data loading operations in OFBiz framework, including initialization, starting, stopping, and data management functions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container, disables services, and loads data for specified delegators or tenants.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container, returns true.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the container (no operation).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container's name.

methods.name: getTenantList
methods.description: Retrieves list of tenants if multitenancy is enabled.

methods.name: loadDataForDelegator
methods.description: Performs data loading operations for a specific delegator, including constraint management and data import.

methods.name: isPropertySet
methods.description: Checks if a property key is set to 'true' or null.

methods.name: getEntityGroupNameFromConfig
methods.description: Retrieves entity group name from configuration or overrides.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Obtains a delegator instance based on configuration or override.

methods.name: getDelegatorFromProp
methods.description: Creates a delegator from a property value.

methods.name: getBaseDelegator
methods.description: Returns the base delegator if tenant-specific, otherwise the same delegator.

methods.name: getHelperInfo
methods.description: Retrieves database helper info for a delegator and entity group.

methods.name: getModelEntities
methods.description: Gets model entity map for a delegator and entity group.

methods.name: createOrUpdateComponentEntities
methods.description: Creates or updates component entity records.

methods.name: dropDbConstraints
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints and indices from the database.

methods.name: createDbConstraints
methods.description: Creates foreign key constraints and indices in the database.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Drops primary keys from database tables.

methods.name: createPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Creates primary keys in database tables.

methods.name: repairDbColumns
methods.description: Repairs database column sizes and structures.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data from URLs into the database, managing transactions and errors.

methods.name: getTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Parses timeout value from string.

methods.name: prepareDataUrls
methods.description: Prepares list of data URLs from files, directories, and readers.

methods.name: getLoadFiles
methods.description: Splits comma-separated file list into individual file paths.

methods.name: isDataReadersEnabled
methods.description: Determines if data readers should be enabled based on inputs.

methods.name: prepareTenantLoadComponents
methods.description: Prepares list of components to load for a tenant.

methods.name: retireveDataUrlsFromFileList
methods.description: Converts file paths to URLs, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveDataUrlsFromDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves data URLs from XML files in a directory.

methods.name: logDataLoadingPlan
methods.description: Logs the plan for data loading.

methods.name: createDataLoadMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted message about data load progress.

methods.name: logDataLoadingResults
methods.description: Logs summary of data load results and errors.
